master: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE unified black-and-white diary-cartoon style master sheet, landscape 1536x1024, pure white background, no lettering, no labels, no paper lines, no panel borders. Input 1 is approved human diary drawing language, input 2 is human expressions and full body, input 3 is ONLY animal drawing-language reference: the cat on LEFT and dog on RIGHT of the packaging. Ignore packaging, logos, text, colored shapes, photography texture, chef outfits and props completely. This is a consistent series extension, not a new generic cute mascot aesthetic. Top half: one fictional short-haired human in plain white T-shirt black shorts, thin white double-outline arms and legs and simple large shoes, full body plus three separate head expressions calm/pleased/slightly tired. Bottom half: a cat and dog full bodies plus two head expressions each. Match human sample's spare clean black outlines, round head, small paired round black eyes no highlights, broad flat open C nose with visible upper facial gap, low lateral mouth, narrow neck, white double-line limbs. Cat: broad softly squared rounded head with small triangular ears, little solid-black nose separated from smile, subtle simple short cheek marks like reference, small compact white body, rounded paws, smooth tail. Dog: elongated rounded muzzle and noticeably large solid-black oval nose as in uploaded photo, asymmetric floppy soft ears, simple dot/arc eyes, smile; no colored tongue, no fur texture, compact white body and rounded paws. Animals natural sitting or four-legged posture, not standing chefs. Consistent single-weight rounded-ended black contours; generous white space, no gray shading no texture no shadows. Cat/dog heads should retain the characterful spare shapes of input3, NOT furry realistic pets. All heads paws tails fully visible. These are fictional style examples, not user identities. Geometry human total standing height ~3 head widths, slender arm/leg width .042H with stroke .012H; paws larger than rods. Black area below20%.

templates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset ID s1-daily. ONE portrait 3:4 image containing exactly 1 SEPARATE illustration vignettes, one per equally spaced horizontal row from top to bottom. Reference image is the single shared style master. Match its SAME human cat and dog drawing language, small black eyes, flat C nose on humans, thin double-outline white limbs, clean round-ended constant black lines, very simplified props. Do not redesign style, do not use realistic texture or colored illustration. Fictional sample characters: the short-haired person in the master; if a second person is needed, same geometry with simple bob haircut and white clothes, no other additions. Cat and dog follow master shape. White interior fills on characters and objects. Background genuinely TRANSPARENT, no paper lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no grids, no borders. Each row has generous blank margins on all sides, each complete scene contained between y=(i+.15)/N and y=(i+.85)/N and x=.08 to .92. Do not let any limbs/props touch a row edge; all feet tails heads intact. Scenery sparse. This will be separated into rows and fit on locally ruled paper with captions later. Scenes in exact order: 1: 坐在小桌前吃面包，旁边一个杯子. No extra panels or repeated mini-scenes. No gray shading, no black ground shadows; black and opaque white only with transparency outside silhouettes.

Keep all characters and furniture whole with large transparent margins between scenes. All people wear a plain T-shirt, shorts and shoes. Flat black outlines, white opaque interior fills, transparent background. No captions, no lettering, no paper lines, no shadows or colors. One person and one cat per scene; no dog or extra character. Use the same spare rounded cartoon shapes as the master, not realistic photography.
